instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: A regional retail bank operating 45 branches across northern Portugal serving 180,000 individual and 12,000 business customers. The core portfolio is robust, focusing on traditional lending products like mortgages and consumer loans, while the digital roadmap focuses on improving existing service channels.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully launched a customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This involved tightening compliance checks within the API structure and optimizing user journeys, leading to an early NPS score increase of 22 points.
answers.strategicGoals: We aim to solidify our position as the trusted local bank by reducing customer churn through enhanced loyalty programs and seamless digital experiences. The primary objective is to build stronger switching costs for existing customers while ensuring operational stability amidst increasing regulatory scrutiny.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently undergoing a core system upgrade which necessitates careful management of innovation spend. There are no significant R&D budgets outside the standard IT maintenance allocation.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Loyalty Ecosystem (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a data-driven loyalty program that offers bespoke product recommendations based on historical transactional behavior could create high switching costs. While requiring significant front-end development, the conservative risk is mitigated by testing this feature in only one branch initially.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study of integrating existing CRM data with marketing automation tools.
Design and prototype the core recommendation engine logic.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: UI/UX development hours for pilot feature
execution_plan.success_metric: Customer retention rate increase of 3% within Q4.
milestones: Prototype completion by end of Month 2
Pilot launch in one key branch by end of Month 4

opportunities.title: Process Automation for Compliance Audits (Conservative)
opportunities.rationale: Automating the preliminary checks required during regulatory audits can drastically reduce manual process time and minimize human error, which is crucial in a high-regulatory environment. This leverages existing internal system knowledge with low financial risk.

first_actions: Map current compliance documentation workflows to identify bottlenecks.
Pilot RPA (Robotic Process Automation) on one specific KYC document verification task.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in compliance reporting preparation time by 40%.
milestones: RPA pilot deployment successful within Month 3

opportunities.title: AI-Assisted Credit Risk Scoring Refinement (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Further refinement of the existing AI credit adjudication tool can improve lending accuracy, which directly supports market defense by allowing for more precise risk pricing and reduced loan defaults. This is a low-cost optimization effort.

first_actions: Gather one year of historical default data for model retraining
Perform A/B testing on the new scoring algorithm versus the current system.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in loan default rate by 0.5% within the fiscal year.
milestones: A/B test results analyzed and recommendation finalized by Month 6.

next_steps.action: Finalize the scope and budget proposal for the Hyper-Personalized Loyalty Ecosystem pilot.
Initiate a cross-functional working group to automate one high-volume compliance process using RPA tools.

key_weaknesses: Limited capacity for innovation due to demanding core operational commitments.
Owner-alone decision-making model risks slowing down necessary mid-level product pivots.
Reliance on high regulatory environment creates constant, low-grade stress and overhead.
Underutilized informal customer feedback channels limit the ability to inform strategic roadmap.
